question.text: What will Salesforce report for GAAP diluted EPS for Q3 FY2027?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the diluted earnings per share (EPS) in conformity with US generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) reported in Salesforce's first official quarterly [earnings release](https://investor.salesforce.com/news/default.aspx) covering its Q3 FY 2027, expected to be released in December 2026.
question.fine_print: Only the initially reported figures encompassing the entirety of the quarter will be considered. Any subsequent revisions, corrections, or restatements will not affect resolution.

## Salesforce Q3 FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS: research brief (as of 2026-11-20)

Salesforce guided Q3 GAAP diluted EPS to $1.81-$1.83. In recent quarters, actual results excluding investment gains came in about $0.1 above guidance, and gains on its strategic investments swung reported EPS by anywhere from $0.21 to $2.43. Anthropic's IPO happened after the quarter closed, so it probably won't be in the Q3 number.

### 1. Resolution source
- The deciding document is the Q3 FY27 earnings release, expected **2026-12-02 after the close** (call at 5:00 p.m. ET). MarketBeat also lists Dec 2. Chartmill lists Dec 1. [tradingnews](https://www.tradingnews.com/news/sales-force-sinks-9-percent-194-usd-at-11-earnings), [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-12-2-salesforcecom-inc-stock/)
- The latest official figure is company guidance from the Q2 release (2026-08-26):
  - Q3 GAAP diluted EPS **$1.81-$1.83**; non-GAAP $3.42-$3.44.
  - Revenue $11.42B-$11.50B, of which slightly over 4 points come from Informatica.
  - Per-share items: amortization $0.57, stock-based compensation $1.29, restructuring and acquisition costs $0.12, tax effects -$0.37.
  - 827M diluted shares; GAAP tax rate about 21.8%.
  - Assumes **no change in the value of the strategic investment portfolio**.
  - Assumes Contentful and Fin close in Q3.
  - Excludes the final settlement of the accelerated share repurchase (ASR), which was expected in October 2026. Q2 diluted shares were 821M.
  [SEC 8-K Ex. 99.1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1108524/000110852426000187/crm-q2fy27xexhibit991.htm)
- Full-year FY27 GAAP EPS guidance is $10.21-$10.25. H1 actual was $6.71 ($2.42 + $4.29), which implies Q4 of about $1.7. [SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1108524/000110852426000187/crm-q2fy27xexhibit991.htm)

### 2. Current status
- Nothing has been reported yet, so the question is not settled.
- The quarter ended 2026-10-31. Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 on 2026-11-18 and started trading 11-19. Both happened **after quarter-end**, so a gain from the IPO would most likely land in Q4 FY27, not Q3. That is my inference from the measurement rules for private investments, not something the company has said. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/18/anthropic-ipo-ai-offering-price.html)
- I found no priced Anthropic transaction between August and October 2026. The last ones were the Series H in May 2026 at $965B, and a tender offer at $350B that finished in April. [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/series-h), [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-08/anthropic-completes-tender-offer-but-employees-hold-onto-shares)

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-18: Anthropic IPO raised about $81.3B at $83 per share, around $1.5T fully diluted. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/18/anthropic-ipo-ai-offering-price.html)
- 2026-11-18: Salesforce's Anthropic stake was worth about $5.1B as of July 31, about 45% of an $11.3B strategic investment portfolio. The stock was around $194. [tradingnews](https://www.tradingnews.com/news/sales-force-sinks-9-percent-194-usd-at-11-earnings)
- 2026-09-03: S&P Global noted the Q3 GAAP EPS guidance of $1.81-$1.83 was **below the $1.90 GAAP consensus before the guidance**. [S&P Global](https://www.spglobal.com/market-intelligence/en/news-insights/research/2026/09/salesforce-postq-ai-momentum-stronger-bookings-support-h2-reacceleration)
- 2026-08-26: Q2 FY27 GAAP EPS was $4.29, including $2,613M in strategic investment gains worth +$2.43 per share. [SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1108524/000110852426000187/crm-q2fy27xexhibit991.htm)

### 4. Base rates (GAAP EPS vs. guidance, and the effect of investment gains)

| Quarter | GAAP guide | Actual | Gains impact | Actual excl. gains |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q3 FY26 (Oct 2025) | not verified | $2.19 | +$0.21 ($263M) | ~$1.98 |
| Q4 FY26 | $1.47-1.49 | not found | +$0.66 | n/a |
| Q1 FY27 | not found | $2.42 | +$0.49 ($558M) | ~$1.93 |
| Q2 FY27 | $1.74-1.76 | $4.29 | +$2.43 | ~$1.86 (about $0.11 above guide midpoint) |

Sources: [Q3 FY26](https://investor.salesforce.com/news/news-details/2025/Salesforce-Delivers-Record-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-2026-Results-Driven-by-Agentforce--Data-360/default.aspx), [Q4 FY26 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1108524/000110852426000056/crm-q4fy26xexhibit991.htm), [Q1 FY27](https://investor.salesforce.com/news/news-details/2026/Salesforce-Delivers-Record-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027-Results/default.aspx)

- Gains on strategic investments have been positive for five straight quarters, ranging from +$0.21 to +$2.43 per share. Before that, Q3 FY25 had a $217M loss and Q1 FY26 a $63M loss.
- Excluding gains, Salesforce has tended to beat its GAAP guidance by about $0.05-$0.15. Non-GAAP beat by $0.39 in Q3 FY26.
- Last year's Q3 GAAP EPS was $2.19, and the year before that $1.58.
- Things that could push Q3 up or down:
  - The ASR final settlement in October would lower the share count slightly, roughly +$0.01-0.02 per share by my estimate.
  - Contentful and Fin closing costs.
  - Mark-to-market changes on public holdings.
  - Funding rounds at other private portfolio companies.

### 5. Other forecasts
- No prediction market covers Q3 GAAP EPS.
- Non-GAAP EPS consensus: $3.43 (MarketBeat), about $3.45-3.47 (TipRanks, Chartmill). [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-12-2-salesforcecom-inc-stock/), [Chartmill](https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/CRM/estimates)
- I could not find a current GAAP EPS consensus. The only figure was S&P's $1.90 from before the guidance.
- Related Polymarket market on Q3 cRPO growth (constant currency): 14-15% at 36%; 16-17% and 17%+ at about 29% each.
- Related Kalshi market on words said during the earnings call, e.g. "OpenAI" at 0.84 and "Contentful" at 0.78. These are not informative on EPS.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-12-02 (or 12-01): the Q3 FY27 release. The 8-K and Exhibit 99.1 will be on SEC EDGAR.
- The main uncertainty is the Q3 strategic investment gain or loss, which is not in guidance. In particular, it is unclear whether Salesforce marked any holding to an observable price during August-October.
- Weather and seasonal outlooks: not relevant.

## Salesforce Q3 FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS: research notes

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-10: Salesforce confirmed it will release Q3 FY27 results (quarter ended Oct 31, 2026) on Wednesday, 2026-12-02, after the market closes, with a webcast at 2:00 p.m. PT. [IR](https://investor.salesforce.com/news/news-details/2026/Salesforce-Announces-Date-of-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-2027-Earnings-Release-and-Webcast/default.aspx)
- 2026-08-26: The latest official figure is the company's Q3 FY27 guidance: GAAP diluted EPS of **$1.81 to $1.83** and non-GAAP of $3.42 to $3.44. Other guidance items:
  - Revenue of $11.42B to $11.50B, of which slightly more than 4 points of growth comes from Informatica.
  - GAAP tax rate of about 21.8%.
  - 827M diluted shares.
  - Restructuring and acquisition costs of about $0.12 per share.
  - **The guidance assumes no change in the value of the strategic investment portfolio.**
  - Full-year FY27 GAAP EPS of $10.21 to $10.25.
  [SEC 8-K Ex. 99.1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1108524/000110852426000187/crm-q2fy27xexhibit991.htm)
- I found no data file that would track this number at higher frequency.

### 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The quarter has closed, but results are not yet released.
- The biggest swing factor is mark-to-market gains on strategic investments, which guidance excludes. The Anthropic stake (about $5.1B as of 2026-07-31, roughly 45% of an $11.3B portfolio) was revalued in Q2 after the May 28 Series H round at $965B. [10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001108524/000110852426000190/crm-20260731.htm), [TNW](https://thenextweb.com/news/salesforce-anthropic-investment-5-billion-ipo)
- I found no priced Anthropic funding round or tender offer between Aug 1 and Oct 31, 2026. The last tender was completed in April 2026. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/28/anthropic-open-ai-startup-value.html), [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-08/anthropic-completes-tender-offer-but-employees-hold-onto-shares)
- The Anthropic IPO was set to price on 2026-11-18 and start trading on 11-19. That is after Q3 closed, so it should fall in Q4 FY27, not Q3. Gains or losses on Salesforce's other private and public holdings in Q3 are still unknown. [TradingNews](https://www.tradingnews.com/news/sales-force-sinks-9-percent-194-usd-at-11-earnings)

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-18: Anthropic's IPO terms were 825M shares at $70 to $78, valuing it at up to about $1.4T. CRM fell about 9% to roughly $194. This article quotes a consensus of $3.24, which looks like a non-GAAP figure and conflicts with other aggregators. [TradingNews](https://www.tradingnews.com/news/sales-force-sinks-9-percent-194-usd-at-11-earnings)
- 2026-09-10: The Fin (formerly Intercom) acquisition, about $3.6B, reportedly closed. This rests on a single blog citing Salesforce. [Shashi](https://www.shashi.co/2026/09/salesforce-closes-fin-and-puts-agents.html?m=0)
- 2026-09-01: The Contentful acquisition, about $1.5B, reportedly closed. Both deals were already built into Q3 guidance. [usagepricing](https://www.usagepricing.com/blueprint/activity/contentful-2026-09-01-salesforce-acquisition-closes)
- September 2026: Benioff said Salesforce may sell its Anthropic stake to repay debt taken on for buybacks. [Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/trading-ideas/movers/26/09/61850399/salesforce-anthropic-stake-worth-tens-of-billions-benioff-plans-to-cash-in)
- 2026-08-26: Q2 FY27 GAAP EPS was $4.29, of which $2.43 came from investment gains. Restructuring cost $94M. [8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1108524/000110852426000187/crm-q2fy27xexhibit991.htm)

### 4. Base rates: guidance vs actual GAAP EPS
| Quarter | Guidance (mid) | Actual GAAP | Investment-gain impact | Actual ex-gains |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q3 FY26 | $1.61 | $2.19 | +$0.21 | ~$1.98 |
| Q4 FY26 | $1.48 | $2.07 | +$0.66 | ~$1.41 |
| Q1 FY27 | $1.78 | $2.42 | +$0.49 | ~$1.93 |
| Q2 FY27 | $1.75 | $4.29 | +$2.43 | ~$1.86 |

Sources: [Q3 FY26](https://investor.salesforce.com/news/news-details/2025/Salesforce-Delivers-Record-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-2026-Results-Driven-by-Agentforce--Data-360/default.aspx), [Q3 FY26 guide](https://seekingalpha.com/pr/20220260), [Q4 FY26](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1108524/000110852426000056/crm-q4fy26xexhibit991.htm), [Q1 FY27](https://www.01net.it/salesforce-delivers-record-first-quarter-fiscal-2027-results/)

- Reported GAAP EPS has beaten the guidance midpoint in each of the last 4 quarters, by +$0.58 to +$2.54. Excluding investment gains, the gap ranged from -$0.07 to +$0.37, and was about +$0.11 to +$0.15 in the last two quarters.
- Gains added $0.21 to $2.43 per quarter, and every one of the last four quarters had a gain. In FY25 there were net losses (-$0.09 for the year), so gains are not guaranteed.
- Seasonality: Q3 GAAP EPS went from $1.58 in Q3 FY25 (my recollection, not verified this session) to $2.19 in Q3 FY26. The diluted share count has fallen sharply, from about 962M to an expected 827M, because of the $27B buyback.

### 5. Other forecasts
- Consensus EPS of about $3.45 to $3.47 ([Chartmill](https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/CRM/estimates), [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/GB:0QYJ/earnings)) is **non-GAAP**. I found no published GAAP consensus.
- Polymarket on Q3 cRPO growth: about 36% for 14 to 15%, and 29% each for 16 to 17% and 17%+. This suggests the market expects results at or above the guide of about 14%. Kalshi has only earnings-call wording markets. I found no market on EPS itself.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-12-02 after the close: the Q3 FY27 earnings release, which resolves the question.
- What could move the number:
  - Gains or impairments on strategic investments other than Anthropic.
  - Restructuring from layoff rounds during 2026.
  - Contentful and Fin integration costs.
  - The tax rate.
- Anthropic's post-IPO trading should affect Q4, not Q3, unless Salesforce treats it differently. That is worth watching for in the footnotes.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** About 12 days. The Q3 FY27 release is expected on 2026-12-02 after the close; one source lists 12-01.

(b) **Latest known value:** Company guidance from the Q2 release (2026-08-26) is Q3 GAAP diluted EPS of $1.81-$1.83. That guidance assumes no change in the value of the strategic investment portfolio. The most recent reported actual was Q2 FY27 GAAP EPS of $4.29, which included +$2.43 per share from investment gains.

(c) **Outcome if nothing changed:** Guidance midpoint of about $1.82, with zero investment gains or losses.

(d) **Outcome if the trend continued:** Excluding gains, results have beaten the guidance midpoint by about $0.05-0.15, which gives roughly $1.90-1.95.
- The ASR settlement adds about $0.01-0.02.
- Strategic investment gains have been positive for five straight quarters, ranging from +$0.21 to +$2.43 per share.
- The Anthropic IPO happened after quarter-end, so it most likely falls in Q4.
- The 2026 AI private-funding boom makes modest positive marks on other holdings likely, perhaps +$0.1 to +$0.4.
- The central estimate is therefore about $2.15.

(e) **Historical variation:** Operating EPS (excluding gains) varies by about ±$0.10 against guidance. Investment gains have swung reported EPS by anywhere from -$0.2 to +$2.4 per share in a single quarter. That swing dominates the uncertainty, and its distribution is skewed upward.

(f) **Expert and market expectations:**
- The pre-guidance GAAP consensus was $1.90 (S&P).
- Non-GAAP consensus is $3.43-3.47, against non-GAAP guidance of $3.42-3.44.
- No market covers GAAP EPS directly.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** A large restructuring charge, heavier-than-expected Contentful or Fin deal costs, impairments on private holdings, and mark-to-market losses on public stakes could push EPS to about $1.55-1.70.
- **High:** An observable Anthropic transaction during Aug-Oct, such as a secondary sale or a pre-IPO round, could trigger a multi-billion-dollar remeasurement inside Q3. Large rounds at Databricks or other holdings would add to it. Together these could push EPS to $3.5-4.5.
